memberdef.name: Two_Sum_Tail
memberdef.initializer: bvirt = (REAL) (x - a); \ avirt = x - bvirt; \ bround = b - bvirt; \ around = a - avirt; \ y = around + bround

memberdef.name: Two_Sum
memberdef.initializer: x = (REAL) (a + b); \ Two_Sum_Tail(a, b, x, y)

memberdef.name: Two_Diff_Tail
memberdef.initializer: bvirt = (REAL) (a - x); \ avirt = x + bvirt; \ bround = bvirt - b; \ around = a - avirt; \ y = around + bround

memberdef.name: Two_Diff
memberdef.initializer: x = (REAL) (a - b); \ Two_Diff_Tail(a, b, x, y)

memberdef.name: Split
memberdef.initializer: c = (REAL) (splitter * a); \ abig = (REAL) (c - a); \ ahi = c - abig; \ alo = a - ahi

memberdef.name: Two_Product_Tail
memberdef.initializer: Split(a, ahi, alo); \ Split(b, bhi, blo); \ err1 = x - (ahi * bhi); \ err2 = err1 - (alo * bhi); \ err3 = err2 - (ahi * blo); \ y = (alo * blo) - err3

memberdef.name: Two_Product
memberdef.initializer: x = (REAL) (a * b); \ Two_Product_Tail(a, b, x, y)

memberdef.name: Two_Product_Presplit
memberdef.initializer: x = (REAL) (a * b); \ Split(a, ahi, alo); \ err1 = x - (ahi * bhi); \ err2 = err1 - (alo * bhi); \ err3 = err2 - (ahi * blo); \ y = (alo * blo) - err3

memberdef.name: Square_Tail
memberdef.initializer: Split(a, ahi, alo); \ err1 = x - (ahi * ahi); \ err3 = err1 - ((ahi + ahi) * alo); \ y = (alo * alo) - err3

memberdef.name: Two_One_Sum

memberdef.name: Two_One_Diff

memberdef.name: Two_Two_Sum
memberdef.initializer: Two_One_Sum(a1, a0, b0, _j, _0, x0); \ Two_One_Sum(_j, _0, b1, x3, x2, x1)

memberdef.name: Two_Two_Diff
